title: TypeScript, Python, and the AI feedback loop changing software development
attributed_claim_summary: GitHub Next leadership argued that AI can influence technology selection before code is written, not merely coding speed.
evidence_or_event: Source-authored report or launch; no original measurements collected in this repository.
limitations: Interpretive interview and platform-linked hypothesis; language mix has multiple confounders.
research_relevance: AI-era coding workflow -> secure functionality -> independent reuse -> lifetime cost; distinguish release availability from observed adoption.
practical_experiment: Measure technology-selection decisions and whether reuse/search was evaluated before generating new code.
